metadata.armyeye:note: Real elevation — Copernicus GLO-30 DEM encoded as raster-dem (Phase D2). DEM = elevation values; terrain = MapLibre geometry from it; hillshade = visualization derived from the same source client-side. Not a sepia street map. Until the archive is installed, availability reports OFFLINE_MAP_DATASET_UNAVAILABLE.
